bullets.text: An elderly woman died and ten women were injured due to an electric shock from a municipal cooling box at a mourning event in Tiruttani, and the office should monitor relief measures.
Around 800 ducks died mysteriously near Uthukottai in Thiruvallur, creating panic among locals, and the district team must watch veterinary department investigations.
An elderly man was killed by a state transport bus near Ponneri old bus stand, and the office should track police action on road safety in the area.
The Madras High Court disposed of cases regarding the NGT construction ban around the Pallikaranai marsh, and the constituency team should watch legal developments.
Chennai Metro Rail Limited issued a notice to correct to two contractors for poor progress on OMR Phase-II works, which the office should monitor.
Tata Group's CaratLane opened its 400th store in Pallikaranai, and the constituency team should note the commercial growth in the area.
Three individuals were arrested in Avadi for usurping 1.59 acres of land worth Rs 2 crore using forged certificates, and the district team should track the police investigation.
The US FDA classified Caplin Point's Gummidipoondi facility as OAI after inspections, and the office should watch the regulatory impacts on the plant.
Commuters beyond Avadi faced difficulties reaching the city after Southern Railway revised suburban train services, which the district team should monitor.
Bodhan AI, an AI center of excellence incubated at IIT Madras, partnered to train over one million school teachers across India, which the portfolio team should note.
Hindustan Institute of Technology and Science launched Tamil Nadu's first university-based centre for future skills with 15 centers of excellence, and the office should support such initiatives.
DMK leadership condemned TVK's proposed new health policy regarding medical and liquor corporation functions, and the office should watch ongoing political debates.
Stalin Duraimurugan was booked by St. Thomas Mount police on three charges over derogatory remarks against TVK, which the office should monitor.
